description: Client-facing contract for asking the server for a qURL link when the client holds only a CRID: the exact knock application body, the closed set of ACK outcome codes, the checks a client runs on an issued link before using it, and the handling of unverified publisher metadata. Every body here is already-decrypted application JSON.
notes: Every CRID, link, address and identifier in this artifact is synthetic conformance data. The fixture link is the published qURL v2 vector link: its issuer key, its resource key and the proof-of-possession secret inside its fragment are public test material. Never admit that issuer key or its kid to a production trust store, and never use those keys outside conformance tests.
This artifact starts after packet decryption: every body is application JSON and no packet bytes appear here. relay_knock_golden.json remains the artifact for the knock and ACK packet format.

request_cases[].serialized is the canonical byte form of request_cases[].body: compact JSON, members in the listed order, strings escaped exactly as JavaScript JSON.stringify escapes them and otherwise emitted as UTF-8.
Member order inside an ACK body is not part of the contract. errMsg is diagnostic text: clients decide on errCode alone, and the errMsg strings here are examples.
An issued link is used only after every client verification check passes. A check that fails is a hard error and nothing from that reply is shown.
redirectInfo is display-only metadata. The publisher name is self-declared and unverified, and nothing in redirectInfo is covered by the link signature or by the CRID.
